name: Emoji Listicle Airhead
effect: Replaces real answers with curt one-line echoes of the prompt ("Three tips for a job interview.", "I think about social media.") or shallow emoji bullet lists of single gerunds, often vacuous or circular and sometimes slightly nonsensical.
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs.
